title: Number Info
description:
Read a positive integer from input. Print whether it is even or odd, whether it is divisible by 3, and its square and square root (rounded to 2 decimal places).

**Example (input: `12`):**
```
12 is Even
12 is divisible by 3
Square: 144
Square root: 3.46
```
starterCode:
# Write your code here
n = int(input())
expectedOutput:
12 is Even
12 is divisible by 3
Square: 144
Square root: 3.46
hint: Use % 2 for even/odd, % 3 for divisibility. Square root: n ** 0.5
